definitions.explanation: The third sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly May 21 to June 21. Also the constellation Gemini. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{双子座|ふたござ}です。
{双子座|ふたござ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{天秤座|てんびんざ}→天秤座：29559_tenbinza⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{相性|あいしょう}がいい→相性がいい：22113_aishougaii⟧らしい。
examples.english: Gemini and Libra are apparently compatible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧で、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{双子座|ふたござ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一位|いちい}→一位：08926_ichii⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: On the morning show, Gemini was introduced as today's number-one sign.

notes:
The zodiac sign Gemini, for people born from late May to late June.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {双子座|ふたござ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person born under Gemini
- {双子座|ふたござ}⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧: born a Gemini
- {双子座|ふたござ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運勢|うんせい}→運勢：15761_unsei⟧: the Gemini horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are common small-talk in Japan and appear in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments (⟦{星占|ほしうらな}い→星占い：18861_hoshiuranai⟧).
